title: UKG Pro pricing - $32-$41 per employee/month for enterprise, fully sales-led
clean_text: UKG Pro is priced per employee per month (PEPM), scaling with workforce size; reported enterprise rates run roughly $32-$41 PEPM, with UKG Pro WFM (adding advanced workforce management) at a similar $32-$40+ PEPM range. The platform follows a modular approach: core payroll, benefits, time, talent management, and BI reporting are sold as add-ons or bundles, with additional modules like performance or learning management adding $5-$15/employee/month. Implementation costs (onboarding, data migration, integration setup, admin training) are charged separately. UKG does not publish rates; pricing is fully sales-led with every quote custom-negotiated.
